title: Scaling as composition changes

design.question: As composition changes (everything else as the default graph), how much money does each society need, and does the gap between traditional and OSO grow?
design.compare: 4 societies on 4 difficulties (composition 0.5, composition 0.7, composition 0.85, composition 0.95)
design.fixed: the simple model: 12 identical agents, equal money each round, no mint, no validation
design.measure: money needed to solve half the targets
design.runs: from the sweeps tagged "one at a time 2026-10-24: composition"

answer: To solve half the targets, traditional needs 6.0× to 7.2× the money OSO needs. By difficulty: composition 0.5 6.0×, composition 0.7 7.2×, composition 0.85 6.7×, composition 0.95 6.6×.
caveats: Read off between the two budgets that bracket half the targets, in log budget.
Each difficulty has its own budget range; "> x" means not reached within it.
